description: §38.5.1 (S479) — the capable alternative to a second `primary key`: a key over several columns is ONE key, written as a table-level `PRIMARY KEY (user_id, team_id)` in a raw `CREATE TABLE` inside the `<schema>` block. It compiles clean: no E-SCHEMA-018, no W-SCHEMA-001. Negative twin: schema/schema-018-second-pk-neg.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S479 "⭐ RULED — the rest of S478 hand-off §3.B, PA recs adopted" item 4: "Capable alternative: table-level `PRIMARY KEY (a, b)` in raw DDL."
rationale: §38.5.1: "A key over several columns is ONE key: it is written as a table-level `PRIMARY KEY (a, b)` in a raw `CREATE TABLE` in the same `<schema>` block". §39.2: "A `<schema>` body MAY also declare a table with raw SQL `CREATE TABLE <name> ( … )` DDL".
